premise: Seal wants to surf like Nico; she slides straight off the spinning rubber ring, until Nico tells her she doesn't need a board, and she rides the wave herself.
inspiration: The 'borrowed feathers' fable (Aesop's jackdaw) turned kind: she doesn't need someone else's thing, she was made for it already.
lesson: You may already have what you need.

en-US.title: The Seal Who Wanted to Surf
en-US.text: {surfer:enter by paddle} Nico grabbed his board and paddled out. {surfer:live ride-wave} Whoosh! Up he stood, riding a wave. {seal:enter} {seal:go to rocks} Seal watched from the rocks. {seal:face happy} {seal:live clap} She clapped her flippers. {sfx:seal solo} She wanted to surf too! {ring:enter} {ring:go to seal} The rubber ring came bobbing by. {seal:go to ring by swim} Seal swam over to try riding it. {ring:live spin} The ring spun round, and round, and round… {seal:spin} and SPLOSH! {sfx:splosh} {seal:face surprised} Off slid Seal. [short pause] Nico called from his board. {surfer:says} [laughs] "Seal! You don't need a board. You can surf all by yourself!" {seal:live nod} So Seal tried. She stretched out long and smooth, and when the next wave came… {seal:glow 0.4} she rode it, whoosh, like a grey, whiskery surfboard! [laughs] {surfer:go to sand by surf} {seal:go to surfer by swim} Side by side, they rode the wave all the way in. {surfer:live wave} Nico waved his board in the air. {seal:face happy} {surfer:face happy} {surfer:says} [excited] "Again?" {seal:hearts} {sfx:seal} Seal couldn't wait.

es-ES.title: La foca que quería hacer surf
es-ES.text: {surfer:enter by paddle} Nico cogió su tabla y remó mar adentro. {surfer:live ride-wave} ¡Fiuuu! Se puso de pie sobre una ola. {seal:enter} {seal:go to rocks} Foca lo miraba desde las rocas. {seal:face happy} {seal:live clap} Dio palmadas con las aletas. {sfx:seal solo} ¡Ella también quería hacer surf! {ring:enter} {ring:go to seal} El flotador pasó meciéndose. {seal:go to ring by swim} Foca nadó hasta él para probar a subirse. {ring:live spin} El flotador dio vueltas, y vueltas, y vueltas… {seal:spin} y ¡CHOF! {sfx:splosh} {seal:face surprised} Foca resbaló al agua. [short pause] Nico la llamó desde su tabla. {surfer:says} [laughs] «¡Foca! No te hace falta tabla. ¡Tú puedes surfear sola!» {seal:live nod} Así que Foca lo intentó. Se estiró, larga y suave, y cuando llegó la siguiente ola… {seal:glow 0.4} ¡la cabalgó, fiuuu, como una tabla de surf gris y con bigotes! [laughs] {surfer:go to sand by surf} {seal:go to surfer by swim} Juntos, cabalgaron la ola hasta la orilla. {surfer:live wave} Nico agitó su tabla en el aire. {seal:face happy} {surfer:face happy} {surfer:says} [excited] «¿Otra vez?» {seal:hearts} {sfx:seal} ¡Foca estaba encantada!

ja-JP.title: サーフィンしたい アザラシさん
ja-JP.text: {surfer:enter by paddle}ニコが、ボードをかかえて、こぎだしました。{surfer:live ride-wave}ざざーっ！すっくと立って、波のりです。{seal:enter}{seal:go to rocks}アザラシさんは、岩の上から見ていました。{seal:face happy}{seal:live clap}ひれで、ぱちぱち。{sfx:seal solo}わたしも、サーフィンしたい！{ring:enter}{ring:go to seal}うきわが、ぷかぷかながれてきました。{seal:go to ring by swim}アザラシさんは、のってみようと、およいでいきます。{ring:live spin}うきわは、くるくる、くるくる…{seal:spin}ざぶーん！{sfx:splosh}{seal:face surprised}アザラシさん、つるーん！[short pause]ニコが、ボードの上からよびかけます。{surfer:says}[laughs]「アザラシさん！ボードは、いらないよ。そのままで、サーフィンできるよ！」 {seal:live nod}よーし、やってみよう。からだを、ながーく、すうっとのばして、つぎの波がきたら…{seal:glow 0.4}すいーっ！まるで、おひげのはえた、はいいろのサーフボード！[laughs]{surfer:go to sand by surf}{seal:go to surfer by swim}ふたりならんで、波にのって、すーっと、もどってきました。{surfer:live wave}ニコは、ボードを高くあげて、ふりました。{seal:face happy}{surfer:face happy}{surfer:says}[excited]「もういっかい？」 {seal:hearts}{sfx:seal}オウッ！アザラシさんは、まちきれません。

de-DE.title: Die Robbe, die surfen wollte
de-DE.text: {surfer:enter by paddle} Nico schnappte sich sein Brett und paddelte hinaus. {surfer:live ride-wave} Wusch! Schon stand er auf dem Brett und surfte auf einer Welle. {seal:enter} {seal:go to rocks} Die Robbe schaute von den Felsen aus zu. {seal:face happy} {seal:live clap} Sie klatschte mit den Flossen. {sfx:seal solo} Sie wollte auch surfen! {ring:enter} {ring:go to seal} Der Schwimmring kam vorbeigeschaukelt. {seal:go to ring by swim} Die Robbe schwamm hin und versuchte, darauf zu reiten. {ring:live spin} Der Ring drehte sich rundherum, rundherum, rundherum… {seal:spin} und PLATSCH! {sfx:splosh} {seal:face surprised} Runter rutschte die Robbe. [short pause] Nico rief von seinem Brett herüber. {surfer:says} [laughs] „Robbe! Du brauchst doch kein Brett. Du kannst ganz allein surfen!“ {seal:live nod} Also probierte es die Robbe. Sie machte sich lang und glatt, und als die nächste Welle kam… {seal:glow 0.4} surfte sie darauf, wusch, wie ein graues Surfbrett mit Schnurrhaaren! [laughs] {surfer:go to sand by surf} {seal:go to surfer by swim} Seite an Seite surften sie auf der Welle zurück an Land. {surfer:live wave} Nico schwenkte sein Brett in der Luft. {seal:face happy} {surfer:face happy} {surfer:says} [excited] „Noch mal?“ {seal:hearts} {sfx:seal} Ark, ark! Die Robbe konnte es kaum erwarten.

fr-FR.title: Le phoque qui voulait surfer
fr-FR.text: {surfer:enter by paddle} Nico a pris sa planche et il a ramé vers le large. {surfer:live ride-wave} Zou ! Le voilà debout sur une vague. {seal:enter} {seal:go to rocks} Phoque le regardait depuis les rochers. {seal:face happy} {seal:live clap} Il a tapé des nageoires. {sfx:seal solo} Lui aussi, il voulait surfer ! {ring:enter} {ring:go to seal} La bouée est passée en dansant sur l’eau. {seal:go to ring by swim} Phoque a nagé jusqu’à elle pour monter dessus. {ring:live spin} La bouée a tourné, et tourné, et tourné… {seal:spin} et PLOUF ! {sfx:splosh} {seal:face surprised} Phoque a glissé dans l’eau. [short pause] Nico l’a appelé depuis sa planche. {surfer:says} [laughs] « Phoque ! Tu n’as pas besoin de planche. Tu peux surfer tout seul ! » {seal:live nod} Alors Phoque a essayé. Il s’est allongé, tout long, tout lisse, et quand la vague suivante est arrivée… {seal:glow 0.4} il l’a surfée, zou, comme une planche de surf grise, avec des moustaches ! [laughs] {surfer:go to sand by surf} {seal:go to surfer by swim} Côte à côte, ils ont glissé sur la vague jusqu’à la plage. {surfer:live wave} Nico a agité sa planche en l’air. {seal:face happy} {surfer:face happy} {surfer:says} [excited] « On recommence ? » {seal:hearts} {sfx:seal} Phoque n’attendait que ça !

it-IT.title: La foca che voleva fare surf
it-IT.text: {surfer:enter by paddle} Nico ha preso la tavola ed è andato al largo, remando. {surfer:live ride-wave} Sciuuu! Si è alzato in piedi, sopra un'onda. {seal:enter} {seal:go to rocks} Foca guardava dagli scogli. {seal:face happy} {seal:live clap} Ha battuto le pinne. {sfx:seal solo} Voleva fare surf anche lei! {ring:enter} {ring:go to seal} Il salvagente è arrivato dondolando. {seal:go to ring by swim} Foca ha nuotato fino a lui, per provare a salirci sopra. {ring:live spin} Il salvagente girava, e girava, e girava… {seal:spin} e SPLASH! {sfx:splosh} {seal:face surprised} Foca è scivolata in acqua. [short pause] Nico l'ha chiamata dalla sua tavola. {surfer:says} [laughs] «Foca! Non ti serve una tavola. Tu sai fare surf da sola!» {seal:live nod} Così Foca ci ha provato. Si è allungata, liscia liscia, e quando è arrivata l'onda dopo… {seal:glow 0.4} l'ha cavalcata, sciuuu, come una tavola da surf grigia e coi baffi! [laughs] {surfer:go to sand by surf} {seal:go to surfer by swim} Fianco a fianco, hanno cavalcato l'onda fino in fondo. {surfer:live wave} Nico ha sventolato la tavola in aria. {seal:face happy} {surfer:face happy} {surfer:says} [excited] «Ancora?» {seal:hearts} {sfx:seal} Foca non vedeva l'ora.

zh-TW.title: 想衝浪的海豹
zh-TW.text: {surfer:enter by paddle}尼可抱起衝浪板，划呀划，划出去了。{surfer:live ride-wave}唰——！他站起來，乘著一道浪。{seal:enter}{seal:go to rocks}海豹在岩石上看著。{seal:face happy}{seal:live clap}啪、啪，牠拍拍鰭。{sfx:seal solo}牠也好想衝浪喔！{ring:enter}{ring:go to seal}游泳圈一搖一晃地漂過來。{seal:go to ring by swim}海豹游過去，想坐上去試試看。{ring:live spin}游泳圈轉呀轉，轉呀轉，轉呀轉……{seal:spin}嘩啦！{sfx:splosh}{seal:face surprised}海豹滑下去了。[short pause]尼可在衝浪板上大聲喊。{surfer:says}[laughs]「海豹！你不用衝浪板啦，你自己就會衝浪！」 {seal:live nod}於是海豹試試看。牠把身體伸得長長的、滑滑的，等下一道浪來的時候……{seal:glow 0.4}牠乘著浪，唰——！就像一塊灰灰的、有鬍鬚的衝浪板！[laughs]{surfer:go to sand by surf}{seal:go to surfer by swim}他們肩並肩，乘著同一道浪，一路衝回來。{surfer:live wave}尼可把衝浪板舉起來揮呀揮。{seal:face happy}{surfer:face happy}{surfer:says}[excited]「再來一次？」 {seal:hearts}{sfx:seal}海豹已經等不及啦！

zh-HK.title: 想滑浪的海豹
zh-HK.text: {surfer:enter by paddle}尼可拿起滑浪板，划了出去。{surfer:live ride-wave}唰！他站起來了，乘着浪滑行。{seal:enter}{seal:go to rocks}海豹在岩石上看着。{seal:face happy}{seal:live clap}牠拍起鰭來。{sfx:seal solo}牠也想滑浪！{ring:enter}{ring:go to seal}水泡一浮一浮地漂了過來。{seal:go to ring by swim}海豹游過去，想坐上去試試。{ring:live spin}水泡轉呀轉，轉呀轉，轉呀轉……{seal:spin}嘩啦！{sfx:splosh}{seal:face surprised}海豹滑了下去。[short pause]尼可在滑浪板上大聲叫牠。{surfer:says}[laughs]「海豹！你唔使用板㗎。你自己都識滑浪㗎！」 {seal:live nod}於是，海豹試試看。牠把身子伸得長長的、滑滑的，下一個浪來的時候……{seal:glow 0.4}牠乘着浪，唰——滑了起來，就像一塊灰色、有鬍鬚的滑浪板！[laughs]{surfer:go to sand by surf}{seal:go to surfer by swim}他們一左一右，乘着浪一直滑回岸上。{surfer:live wave}尼可把滑浪板舉起來，揮呀揮。{seal:face happy}{surfer:face happy}{surfer:says}[excited]「再嚟一次？」 {seal:hearts}{sfx:seal}海豹早就急不及待了！

splosh.prompt: something sliding off into the sea with a big wet splosh, playful

seal.prompt: a grey seal calling from the rocks by the sea: a long, low, wavering moan, 'hoooo', rising and falling, like a seal singing, realistic wildlife field recording, no dog, no barking
